Today's AI briefing from The Gradient | 2026-11-22

1. Hebbia sees improvements in financial research with GPT-6 Astra
Hebbia ran prerelease evaluations of GPT‑6 Astra on its financial research workflows.

2. Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
Google unveiled Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API, a preview feature that lets agents automatically fetch the most relevant external tools from a catalog of hundreds, reducing the need to explicitly prompt for each tool.

3. The Gemini app is now available on lower-memory Android devices.
Google released an update to the Gemini app that removes the previous RAM requirement, allowing phones with as little as 2 GB of memory to run Gemini Live and generate custom images.
